1.w: My spirit is broken, my days have faded out; the grave awaits me.

2.w: Surely mockery is with me; my eyes must dwell on their hostility.

3.w: Set my pledge beside you. Who else will put up security for me?

4.w: Because you have closed their minds to understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

5.w: If a man denounces his friends for personal gain, the eyes of his children will fail.

6.w: He has made me a byword to people; I am the one in whose face they spit.

7.w: My eyes have grown dim with grief; my whole frame is but a shadow.

8.w: Upright men are appalled at this; the innocent man is troubled with the godless.

9.w: But the righteous man holds to his way, and the one with clean hands grows stronger.

10.w: “But turn, all of you, and come now! I will not find a wise man among you.

11.w: My days have passed; my plans are shattered, even the desires of my heart.

12.w: These men change night into day; they say, ‘The light is near in the face of darkness.’

13.w: If I hope for the grave to be my home, if I spread out my bed in darkness,

14.w: if I cry out to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ or ‘My sister,’

15.w: where then is my hope? And my hope, who sees it?

16.w: Will it go down to the barred gates of death? Will we descend together into the dust?”
